metadata.description: A detailed jewelry design sketch featuring a grand, traditional Indian necklace and a matching earring. The necklace has a prominent central teardrop-shaped element, flanked by intricate peacock-like motifs, and a cascading, multi-tiered structure. It is adorned with numerous small, round stones (suggesting diamonds) and larger heart/teardrop-shaped pink gemstones, identified as Tourmaline. The upper part of the necklace forms a collar-like design with golden-toned, leaf-like elements. The overall aesthetic is rich and elaborate, indicative of heritage jewelry.
